## Core entities

- MASA / 山田昌寛: educator and former Japan national-team sepak takraw athlete; founder of ACE METHOD.
- ACE METHOD (Athlete Cognitive Education): an educational/coaching framework connecting cognition, embodied experience, learning, and action.
- sun loves flow: the broader learning and knowledge ecosystem connected to MASA's work.
